ex.line: The interest on Linyuan's debt now outpaces what the timber can bring in; the numbers have been quietly rearranged twice to hide it, and there is no third arrangement that works.
Linyuan owes an outside power more than it can ever repay, and the debt now decides what it can and cannot do.

Rotbach's notices are posted in two languages now, the local one second. The new lettering is neat, official, and on every door that matters, which is how you learn the occupation intends to stay. Ögedeikum smells of vinegar and woodsmoke. Doors that should be open are shut, and the people who do come out keep a careful distance from one another, and from you. Something is spreading in Ögedeikum. It is not yet a plague, but it will be if nothing changes. The sick outnumber those who can tend them. The origin is disputed. Quarantine measures are being resisted.
